options.content:
- **Use case:** Automated PR review analytics from Cursor BugBot (`GET /analytics/team/bugbot-reviews`).
- **Data source:** Cursor plugin — requires `hasBugbotReviews` on the connection.
- **Related:** [Cursor Usage & Cost](/d/cursor_usage) for usage, cost, and AI code tracking.

panels.description: Completed BugBot reviews in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Reviews"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Total Reviews

panels.description: Sum of bugs_found across reviews in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(bugs_found) AS "Findings"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Total Findings

panels.description: Share of findings marked resolved vs findings with a resolution status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN f.resolution_status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.resolution_status IN ('resolved', 'unresolved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Resolution Rate"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews r
JOIN _tool_cursor_bugbot_findings f
  ON r.connection_id = f.connection_id
  AND r.scope_id = f.scope_id
  AND r.request_id = f.request_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND r.scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Resolution Rate

panels.description: Sum of review cost (cost_cents / 100) in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(cost_cents, 0)) / 100 AS "Cost"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'

panels.title: Total Review Cost

panels.description: Completed BugBot reviews per day from GET /analytics/team/bugbot-reviews, stacked by publication status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(publication_status, ''), 'unknown') AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), metric
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Review Volume by Status

panels.description: Total BugBot review cost (cost_cents / 100) over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS time,
  SUM(COALESCE(cost_cents, 0)) / 100 AS "Review Cost"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY DATE(timestamp)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: BugBot Cost Over Time

panels.description: Share of findings marked resolved vs total findings with a resolution status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(r.timestamp) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.resolution_status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN f.resolution_status IN ('resolved', 'unresolved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Resolution Rate"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews r
JOIN _tool_cursor_bugbot_findings f
  ON r.connection_id = f.connection_id
  AND r.scope_id = f.scope_id
  AND r.request_id = f.request_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND r.scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY DATE(r.timestamp)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Finding Resolution Rate

panels.description: Finding counts by severity over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(r.timestamp) AS time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.severity, ''), 'unknown') AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews r
JOIN _tool_cursor_bugbot_findings f
  ON r.connection_id = f.connection_id
  AND r.scope_id = f.scope_id
  AND r.request_id = f.request_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND r.scope_id = '${scope_id}'
GROUP BY DATE(r.timestamp), metric
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Finding Severity Over Time

panels.description: Repositories ranked by total bugs_found in the selected period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repo AS "Repo",
  COUNT(*) AS "Reviews",
  SUM(bugs_found) AS "Findings",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(cost_cents, 0)) / 100, 2) AS "Cost ($)"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND repo != ''
GROUP BY repo
ORDER BY SUM(bugs_found) DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Repos by Findings

panels.description: Average bugs found per pull request by repository

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repo AS "Repo",
  pr_number AS "PR",
  COUNT(*) AS "Reviews",
  ROUND(AVG(bugs_found), 2) AS "Avg Findings",
  SUM(bugs_found) AS "Total Findings"
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND pr_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY repo, pr_number
ORDER BY AVG(bugs_found) DESC, SUM(bugs_found) DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Average Bugs per PR

panels.description: Row counts and latest timestamps for BugBot tool tables

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '_tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(timestamp) AS latest
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_reviews
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
UNION ALL
SELECT '_tool_cursor_bugbot_findings', COUNT(*), NULL
FROM _tool_cursor_bugbot_findings
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id} AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
